problems.title: The three leaks every tuition class knows.
problems.subtitle: Each one costs you money every month. ReMix closes all three from day one.

leaks.title: Lessons leaked to Telegram
leaks.body: Encrypted streaming with a moving student-ID watermark. If a clip leaks, you know exactly whose account it came from.

sharing.title: One account, ten students
sharing.body: Two devices per student, and Zoom locks every join to the student's registered name. Shared logins stop working.

fees.title: Chasing fees and bank slips
fees.body: Students pay by card or upload the slip from their phone. Your cashier approves each one with a single key.

features.title: One system for the hall, the Zoom room and the fee counter.

website.title: Your own website
website.body: A class website on your own domain, with your timetable, fees and results. Build it from blocks, no developer needed.

fees.title: Fees and bank slips
fees.body: PayHere card payments, bank slip uploads and a cash counter for your cashier. See who has paid for October at a glance.

video.title: Protected video
video.body: Encrypted streaming with each student's ID moving across the screen. Only paid months unlock.

zoom.title: Zoom with name lock
zoom.body: Students join from the portal under their registered name. Zoom attendance lands in ReMix automatically.

gate.title: Offline gate attendance
gate.body: QR or NFC cards at the hall door. The gate app checks fees and keeps scanning when the internet drops.

parents.title: Parents in the loop
parents.body: An SMS when their child is absent or a fee is due. Parents see attendance and payments in one place.

pricing.title: Pay per student, not per class card.
pricing.subtitle: A student in three of your classes counts once. Students who don't pay or log in during the month are free.
pricing.question: How many active students do you have?
pricing.assumption: Assumes {classes} classes per student and {perCard} per class card.

faq.title: Questions institutes ask us
faq.contact: Something else? <link>Ask us on WhatsApp</link>, we reply in Sinhala, Tamil or English.

safety.a: Each institute's data is kept separate from every other institute. Connections are encrypted and backups run every night. Recca Labs staff can only open your account through a recorded support session, and you see a banner while it runs.

migration.q: Can you move our students from another system?
migration.a: Yes, for free. Send us an Excel or CSV export, or your current student list, and we import students, classes and fee history before your first month starts.

payments.a: Card payments through PayHere, bank transfers with a slip upload, and cash at your counter. All three land in the same fee records, so a student is never marked unpaid by mistake.

languages.q: Does it work in Sinhala and Tamil?
languages.a: Yes. The student portal, your website and the admin area all switch between Sinhala, Tamil and English. Each person picks their own language.

offline.q: What happens if the internet goes down at the hall?
offline.a: The ReMix+ gate app keeps scanning offline using the fee list it synced that morning. Scans upload as soon as the connection comes back.
